name: Calendar
description: The next meeting from your calendars: its title, countdown, times and meeting link as status segments (`next`, `next_title`, `next_in`, `next_minutes`, `next_start`, `next_end`, `next_ongoing`, `next_link`), `calendar join`, which opens its meeting link, and `calendar next`, which shows it.

calendars.description: Calendar titles to read, as Calendar shows them; empty reads every calendar.

lookahead_hours.description: How far ahead the next event may start, in hours.

commands.description: Open the meeting link of the next or current calendar event
